youtube_full.title: Sure as the Morning | Bedtime Scripture Story for Kids | Hosea 6:1–3
youtube_full.description:
Sure as the Morning: a bedtime scripture story for kids from Hosea 6:1–3.

Heavenly Father’s people had wandered far away, and they missed Him. In Hosea’s book, they said, “Come, let’s go back to the Lord.”

Tonight's Scripture Traveler: Scout the Seeker.

Read along as the pages turn, then answer the bedtime questions together.

0:00 Opening the book
0:11 The story: Sure as the Morning
1:09 Scripture Traveler of the Night: Scout the Seeker
1:47 A Feeling Moment and the Five Stones
2:55 Question time
3:13 Sweet dreams
3:30 More stories, the app and the paperback
